question: Show the top 5 customers by total spending.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS total_spending FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show all customers from Hyderabad.
sql: SELECT id, name, city, email FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hyderabad';

question: What are the top 3 most expensive products?
sql: SELECT id, name, category, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many products are there in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: Show all completed orders.
sql: SELECT id, customer_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Find customers who have placed orders.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;
